@wllama/wllama 3.13.0 (published 2026-11-08): esm/index.js (unchanged) and esm/wasm/wllama.wasm (10.2 MB, unchanged). MIT, see LICENCE-wllama.txt.
It is the llama.cpp inference engine compiled to WebAssembly. No build tool or other library is needed.
Model (downloaded by the phone from Hugging Face, not stored in this repo): bartowski/google_gemma-3-270m-it-GGUF, file google_gemma-3-270m-it-Q8_0.gguf (Gemma Terms of Use).
